description: Analyze binary GCD convergence rate: E[iterations] ~ 0.706*n for n-bit inputs. Use this to set fixed iteration bounds and eliminate loop-termination branch.
implementation_hypothesis: Fixed upper bound of ceil(1.5*n) iterations. After that, one operand guaranteed to be 0. No data-dependent loop exit.
experiment_seed: Empirically measure iteration count over 10M random pairs. Verify theoretical bounds.
